messages:
maria: FYI I pulled the quarterly recurrence heatmap and a short list of repeat causes. Wanted to share before the retro tomorrow so we can assign owners and realistic timelines.
ajay: thanks Maria — can you drop the link to the doc?
maria: here — https://drive.redwood/internals/incidents/q3-patterns (view only for folks not in IR team)
kevin: skimmed it. the top 3 are: cold-start latency spikes, batch backpressure leading to retries, and node drain flaps during rolling upgrades.
sarah: +1. we also keep seeing a variant of the KV-cache invalidation bug in low RPS tails. likely cross-cut with cold-starts.
lia: would help to prioritize by customer impact not just frequency. a 10% slowdown for a big customer > 100 small failures.
maria: agreed. I added a simple impact score column (freq * customer_weight). see sheet tab "heatmap-v2"
ops-bot: New postmortem added: PM-2026-072 (node drain flap) — https://pm.redwood/incidents/PM-2026-072 :eyes:
ajay: can we convert the top causes into concrete remediation tasks? I started a draft action list in the doc.
maria: pasted below snapshot of proposed actions. please react with :thumbsup: if you own or :eyes: if you can support.

```
Action ID,Action,Owner,Support,Due,Status
A101,Improve warmup on cold start,maria,eng-runtime,2026-05-15,proposed
A102,Backpressure circuit breaker + faster retries,ajay,eng-sre;eng-platform,2026-05-30,proposed
A103,KV-cache instrumentation + alerting,kevin,eng-ml;observability,2026-05-10,proposed
A104,Drain-safety: pre-check hooks + concurrency limits,sarah,eng-infra,2026-04-28,in-progress
A105,Customer-impact prioritization matrix,lia,product;cs,2026-04-20,proposed
```

kevin: I'll take A103 but will need one sprint of eng-ml support. setting milestone in JIRA now.
sarah: A104 almost done — PR for pre-check hooks up. need QA from infra tomorrow.
ajay: taking A102. question: do we prefer circuit-breaker at runtime or at proxy layer? my leaning: do a short-term proxy rule now, then runtime for long-term.
maria: yep, that plan fits timelines. put proxy as quick mitigation with 2-week TTL.
lia: I'll own A105. will sync with CS next Monday to get customer weights.
kevin: small ask — add an explicit rollback plan to A101 and A102 in case warmup or CB causes regressions. we should include canary gating.
maria: good call. updated the sheet.
ops-bot: Reminder: action owner assignments updated in Tracker (https://tracker.redwood/actions/1846874321)
ajay: question about sequencing — should A103 instrumentation happen before A102 changes so we can measure?
sarah: yes for data-driven. but A102 short-term proxy doesn't need it. sequence: A103 (instrument) -> short proxy -> runtime CB.
maria: proposed timeline in doc reflects that. can folks confirm ownership by EOD? I want to roll this into the retro notes and the postmortem follow-up board.
kevin: confirmed. I'll update JIRA ticket and link.
lia: confirmed. I'll add CS contacts and target customers.
ajay: confirmed. starting work on proxy rules tomorrow.
sarah: confirmed and will get QA scheduled.
maria: thanks team. last item: recurring-review cadence — propose monthly check-ins for the top 5 patterns and quarterly deep-dive on the heatmap. prefer short 30m sync.
kevin: monthly + quarterly sounds right.
lia: +1 30m is enough.
ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: Recurring Incident Review (monthly) — next: 2026-04-15 10:00 UTC
maria: I'll add the action list to the incident board and ping owners weekly until closed. ping me if you need re-prioritization.
ajay: linking a quick snippet for the proxy patch we'll run:

```
# nginx snippet for short-term backpressure rule
proxy_next_upstream error timeout invalid_header http_502 http_503;
more_set_headers "X-Redwood-Backpressure: true";
# TTL: 2 weeks - monitor X-Redwood-Backpressure header rate
```

kevin: nice. I'll watch the metrics and flag regressions.
sarah: PR: https://git.redwood/eng-infra/drain-safety/pulls/42 — reviewers: @maria @kevin
maria: added reviewers. thanks. closing thread for now — we'll use tracker links for updates.
